Document edit - call sequence and computational dependencies
|
|-- [C] UI or live agent bridge
|   `-- MappingDocumentController.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
|       |
|       |-- 1. Validate and stage
|       |   |-- [D] expected version + current version -> conflict check
|       |   `-- [D] document + interaction state -> staged state
|       |
|       |-- 2. Apply operations
|       |   |-- Content change -> [C] DiagramService.create / revise
|       |   |   `-- [D] content + source evidence + base revision
|       |   |       `-- New immutable revision + node correspondence
|       |   `-- Instance / view change -> boxes / edges / sections / views
|       |
|       |-- 3. Derive consistent layout and presentation
|       |   |-- [D] ASCII dimensions + box hierarchy -> final cell bounds
|       |   |   `-- Anchor changed box; push colliding siblings
|       |   |-- [D] content changes + correspondence -> endpoint reconciliation
|       |   |   `-- Retained / reanchored / stale endpoints
|       |   `-- [D] grid bounds + placement policies -> floating pixel bounds
|       |       `-- Constraint: floating bounds never displace GridBoxes
|       |
|       `-- 4. Commit and publish
|           |-- [C] CanvasHistoryService.append
|           |   `-- [D] document + view + correspondence
|           |       `-- Checkpoint + advanced version
|           `-- [C] Notify subscribers with updated snapshot
|               `-- Session onCommit() -> workspace persistence notification
|
|-- [M] commitDocument(...): document and layout edits
`-- [M] updateCanvas(...) / select(...): pane / control / selection
    `-- Ordinary controls and measurements add no checkpoint

Numbers describe the seed's flow, not a proven atomic transaction.
Unspecified: conflict response, rollback, retries and durability timing.
